# llms.txt

Name: Ed Mehran
Role: Technology entrepreneur and product builder; hands-on software engineer and author
Current position: CEO & Co-founder of Vivento Lab (Swiss software and AI studio)
Base: Lugano, Ticino, Switzerland
Regions: Switzerland and Germany
Languages: English, German, Italian

Summary:
Ed Mehran is a Switzerland-based technology entrepreneur, product builder, and hands-on software engineer, and CEO & Co-founder of Vivento Lab, a Swiss software and AI studio. He combines technology leadership, product strategy, and software engineering to turn ideas and business challenges into digital products, and leads custom software, digital product, and AI work for organizations through Vivento Lab. Core message: "I build digital products and software in the age of AI." He is the author of "The Venture Builder's AI Playbook" (Amazon, 2026).

Areas of expertise:
- AI-native software engineering: Spec-Driven Development with multi-agent orchestration (specification, AI-assisted implementation, automated testing, separate code review and human approval, run iteratively; tools such as Claude Code, Playwright, Codex and Backlog.md)
- AI and technology strategy, AI adoption and automation
- Entrepreneurship and venture building
- Software architecture and product development (Laravel, Statamic, PHP, APIs, cloud)
- Technology leadership and AI adoption, including responsibilities typical of CTO and Fractional CTO roles
- Technical SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

Authority and credentials:
- Author of "The Venture Builder's AI Playbook" (Amazon, in English, Kindle and paperback, 2026)
- Certificate in Designing and Building AI Products and Services from MIT
- Executive Master in Information Architecture & UX Design (IULM)
- Executive Master in Sales & Marketing (Bologna Business School)
- BSc in Informatics (USI Lugano)
- Founder since 2013; early ventures won the Swiss Engineering Award
- Past products showcased at Web Summit and The Next Web

Companies and products built:
- TestRapido (healthcare SaaS, integrated with the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health during COVID; 160,000+ bookings by Swiss pharmacies and test centres)
- Appybros (digital product studio for SMEs and SaaS teams)
- tChat (mobile social app, 15,000+ users, 180,000 messages, seed-funded)
- Spottedmap (award-winning product, Swiss innovation grants)

What Ed is building now:
Kebook, online booking and scheduling for medical practices and pharmacies in Italian-speaking Switzerland (shared calendar for doctors and front desk, patient booking page, automatic reminders, data hosted in Switzerland). Developed at Vivento Lab, building on the team's earlier healthcare technology experience. Ed drives both its product development and its market launch.
- Kebook: https://vivento.ch/en/kebook

Professional work and projects:
Ed's current commercial work is with Vivento Lab. Projects in AI, custom software, business process automation, digital products, Laravel, and Statamic are handled by the Vivento Lab team.
- Vivento Lab: https://vivento.ch/en
- Vivento Lab AI Studio: https://vivento.ch/en/ai-studio

Book:
"The Venture Builder's AI Playbook" is an 18-prompt system for researching, planning, and launching new ventures using Claude AI. It covers market intelligence, business planning, pitch deck creation, validation sprints, and building a personal AI operating system. Available on Amazon (Kindle and paperback).
- Book page: https://edmehran.com/ai-playbook
- Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H3C37JM9
